title: PIXL 8000 Cherry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Ice pairs a bold Cherry flavour with a streak of cool Menthol for a vape that’s fruity, bright, and refreshing. The juicy, slightly tangy base is lifted by a clean, icy finish. Each pod includes 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is bundled with a 10ml refill reservoir. Used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this combo offers up to 8000 puffs. Mesh coil tech ensures reliable vapour and flavour delivery throughout. Designed for MTL vaping with a draw-activated system and optional Boost Mode, this pod is easy to use and satisfyingly flavourful. Cherry Ice is a popular flavour in the PIXL 8000 lineup for vapers who enjoy a cool fruit vape with depth.
